segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַזּוֹרֵק אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת בַּכּוֹתֶל, לְמַעְלָה מֵעֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים — כְּזוֹרֵק בָּאֲוִיר. לְמַטָּה מֵעֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים — כְּזוֹרֵק בָּאָרֶץ. הַזּוֹרֵק בָּאָרֶץ אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת — חַיָּיב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who throws» an object «four cubits» in the public domain, if the object hits «the wall above ten handbreadths» from the ground, which is an exempt domain, it is «as if one threw it in the air,» and he is exempt. If it hits the wall «below ten handbreadths» from the ground, it is «as if he threw it» and it landed «on the ground, and one who throws» an object «four cubits» and it lands «on the ground is liable.»

moves.summary: Above ten is like air; below ten is like the ground and liable.

positions.claim: hitting the wall above ten is like throwing in the air (exempt); below ten is like throwing on the ground (liable)

unresolved.note: no interactions between parties in this mishna
